Design [[blueprint]]s. All those reactions need a flask and a piece of paper, papyrus or vellum. They have a 10-15% to give you the wanted item.

You can also train your [[cv:Architect|Architect]] here.

Blueprints are needed for the [[Weaponry]], [[Armory]], [[Rune weaponry]], [[Rune armory]], [[Gunsmith]], [[Colosseum]], [[Machine factory]], [[Great magma forge]] and [[Warpstone Lab]]. This is done to slow down the progress a bit.

WARNING: These reactions have a chance to fail in several ways.
